name: feedback
description: Feedback collection for Hasna-coded apps: a CLI, an MCP server, an HTTP API, and a TypeScript client. The default store is SQLite at ~/.hasna/feedback/feedback.db; FEEDBACK_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL selects the PostgreSQL store. The legacy append-only JSONL file at ~/.hasna/feedback/feedback.jsonl remains supported for rollback.

serviceSurfaces.name: feedback-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The TypeScript client ships and works against the live /v1 API, but the service contract requires a supported service SDK to be generated from the API's OpenAPI document, and feedback-serve publishes no /openapi.json (see the deferred HTTP API surface).

serviceSurfaces.name: feedback-http-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The HTTP API ships and serves GET /health plus the /v1 routes, but it does not meet the v1 service topology: there is no GET /ready, no GET /version, and no /openapi.json. GET /health also returns { ok, service, version } rather than the contract's { status, version, backend }. Declaring this surface supported today would assert routes that do not exist.

conformance.notes: The legacy JSONL store (HASNA_FEEDBACK_STORE=jsonl) is not expressible in the contract's storage engine enum; the declared engines are the SQLite default and the FEEDBACK_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL-selected PostgreSQL store.
